clips.text: Painting he tells us is of a different quality to mathematics and finish in art is adding more effect.

clips.text: As for etchings, there are two kinds, British and foreign.

clips.ref: HE LAMENTS MOST BITTERLY THE DIVORCE THAT HAS BEEN MADE BETWEEN DECORATIVE ART AND WHAT WE USUALLY CALL PICTURES MAKES THE CUSTOMARY APPEAL TO THE LAST JUDGMENT AND REMINDS US THAT IN THE GREAT DAYS OF ART MICHAEL ANGELO WAS THE FURNISHING UPHOLSTERER
clips.text: He laments most bitterly the divorce that has been made between decorative art and what we usually call pictures makes a customary appeal to the last judgment and reminds us that in the great days of art, Michelangelo was the furnishing upholsterer.
